_metadata.product: Sargas International's Chronic Care Management Cloud dba hru2day
_metadata.notes: No data dictionary exists. The entire EHI export documentation is a single 1-page PDF with 6 sentences. It describes the export as a ZIP containing per-encounter C-CDA XML files and PDF attachments. No entities, tables, fields, or schemas are documented. This inventory reflects what can be inferred from the documentation — not what is actually in the export.

inferred_content.description: Based on the documentation, the export contains two types of content, but no field-level or entity-level detail is provided for either.

components.name: C-CDA Documents
components.packaging: Nested ZIP archives within outer ZIP
components.notes: The documentation does not specify which C-CDA sections are populated, what data elements are included, or which C-CDA template/profile is used.

components.name: PDF Attachments
components.packaging: Within outer ZIP alongside C-CDA ZIPs
components.granularity: Unknown — described only as 'PDF files attached to the patient's chart'
components.notes: No description of what types of documents these PDFs represent (scanned records, lab reports, consent forms, etc.).
